<a id="gcode_macro-cancel_print"></a>

## gcode_macro CANCEL_PRINT

Mainsail's cancellation wrapper: optionally park, retract if hot, shut off heaters and call the configured cleanup hook, then cancel the underlying print. In this pilot park_at_cancel is false and cleanup owns parking; cancel_retract is normally 15mm and becomes zero after an M600 unload.

**Calls and state references:** [RESUME](mainsail.cfg.md#gcode_macro-resume), [SET_PAUSE_AT_LAYER](mainsail.cfg.md#gcode_macro-set_pause_at_layer), [SET_PAUSE_NEXT_LAYER](mainsail.cfg.md#gcode_macro-set_pause_next_layer), [_CLIENT_RETRACT](mainsail.cfg.md#gcode_macro-_client_retract), [_CLIENT_VARIABLE](macros/client.cfg.md#gcode_macro-_client_variable), [_TOOLHEAD_PARK_PAUSE_CANCEL](mainsail.cfg.md#gcode_macro-_toolhead_park_pause_cancel), [_SV_CANCEL_CLEANUP](macros/client.cfg.md#gcode_macro-_sv_cancel_cleanup). ## gcode_macro PAUSE

Mainsail's pause wrapper: save nozzle target/timeout information, invoke the underlying pause, run an optional user hook and park. The pilot normally retracts 1mm; M600 temporarily suppresses that retract before its own unload.

**Calls and state references:** [RESUME](mainsail.cfg.md#gcode_macro-resume), [_CLIENT_VARIABLE](macros/client.cfg.md#gcode_macro-_client_variable), [_TOOLHEAD_PARK_PAUSE_CANCEL](mainsail.cfg.md#gcode_macro-_toolhead_park_pause_cancel), [_LCD_STATUS_PAUSED](options/lcd/macros.cfg.md#gcode_macro-_lcd_status_paused). <a id="gcode_macro-resume"></a>

## gcode_macro RESUME

Unmodified Mainsail resume wrapper: handle its configured restoration policy, require an acceptable filament-sensor state, run the configured resume hook, prime and invoke the underlying resume. The pilot pause hook disables Mainsail's early temperature restoration while retaining its saved target, and the pilot resume hook performs sensor-first reheating and M600-specific behavior.

**Calls and state references:** [_CLIENT_EXTRUDE](mainsail.cfg.md#gcode_macro-_client_extrude), [_CLIENT_VARIABLE](macros/client.cfg.md#gcode_macro-_client_variable), [_SV_RESUME_CHECK](macros/client.cfg.md#gcode_macro-_sv_resume_check). Conditional references are not necessarily executed.

<a id="gcode_macro-set_pause_next_layer"></a>

## gcode_macro SET_PAUSE_NEXT_LAYER

Store whether the next layer update should pause, and which macro to invoke. It schedules behavior through SET_PRINT_STATS_INFO; it does not immediately pause.

**Calls and state references:** [SET_PRINT_STATS_INFO](mainsail.cfg.md#gcode_macro-set_print_stats_info), [PAUSE](mainsail.cfg.md#gcode_macro-pause), [M600](macros/client.cfg.md#gcode_macro-m600). Conditional references are not necessarily executed.

**Runtime-selected calls:** <code>pause_next_layer.call</code>. Hook/state links above describe the known owners; external runtime values may select other commands.

| Source line | Code | Plain explanation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [176](../config/mainsail.cfg#L176) | <code>[gcode_macro SET_PAUSE_NEXT_LAYER]</code> | Declare this callable macro. |
| [177](../config/mainsail.cfg#L177) | <code>description: Enable a pause if the next layer is reached</code> | Set the help text: <code>Enable a pause if the next layer is reached</code>. |
| [178](../config/mainsail.cfg#L178) | <code>gcode:</code> | Begin the command template. The following indented lines belong to it. |
| [179](../config/mainsail.cfg#L179) | <code>{% set pause_next_layer = printer[&#x27;gcode_macro SET_PRINT_STATS_INFO&#x27;].pause_next_layer %}</code> | Calculate local <code>pause_next_layer</code> from <code>the stored state of SET_PRINT_STATS_INFO.pause_next_layer</code>. It lasts for this evaluation only. |
| [180](../config/mainsail.cfg#L180) | <code>{% set ENABLE = params.ENABLE&#124;default(1)&#124;int != 0 %}</code> | Calculate local <code>ENABLE</code> from <code>the supplied ENABLE argument (use 1 if absent) as an integer  differs from  0</code>. It lasts for this evaluation only. |
| [181](../config/mainsail.cfg#L181) | <code>{% set MACRO = params.MACRO&#124;default(pause_next_layer.call, True) %}</code> | Calculate local <code>MACRO</code> from <code>the supplied MACRO argument (use pause_next_layer.call, True if absent)</code>. It lasts for this evaluation only. |
| [182](../config/mainsail.cfg#L182) | <code>SET_GCODE_VARIABLE MACRO=SET_PRINT_STATS_INFO VARIABLE=pause_next_layer VALUE=&quot;{{ &#x27;enable&#x27;: ENABLE, &#x27;call&#x27;: MACRO }}&quot;</code> | Store <code>&quot;{{ &#x27;enable&#x27;: ENABLE, &#x27;call&#x27;: MACRO }}&quot;</code> in the named macro's <code>pause_next_layer</code> variable for later calls. This changes runtime state, not the config file. |

<a id="gcode_macro-set_print_stats_info"></a>

## gcode_macro SET_PRINT_STATS_INFO

Intercept layer updates to run a requested next-layer or numbered-layer pause, clear that one-shot request, then forward the original layer information to Klipper.

**Calls and state references:** [SET_PAUSE_AT_LAYER](mainsail.cfg.md#gcode_macro-set_pause_at_layer), [SET_PAUSE_NEXT_LAYER](mainsail.cfg.md#gcode_macro-set_pause_next_layer), [PAUSE](mainsail.cfg.md#gcode_macro-pause), [M600](macros/client.cfg.md#gcode_macro-m600). Conditional references are not necessarily executed.

<a id="gcode_macro-_client_extrude"></a>

## gcode_macro _CLIENT_EXTRUDE

If an active extruder is hot enough, perform the requested filament movement using firmware retraction or relative E moves. Restore absolute E mode when necessary. Otherwise report that extrusion is unavailable.

**Calls and state references:** [_CLIENT_VARIABLE](macros/client.cfg.md#gcode_macro-_client_variable). Conditional references are not necessarily executed.

| Source line | Code | Plain explanation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [256](../config/mainsail.cfg#L256) | <code>[gcode_macro _CLIENT_EXTRUDE]</code> | Declare this callable macro. |
| [257](../config/mainsail.cfg#L257) | <code>description: Extrudes, if the extruder is hot enough</code> | Set the help text: <code>Extrudes, if the extruder is hot enough</code>. |
| [258](../config/mainsail.cfg#L258) | <code>gcode:</code> | Begin the command template. The following indented lines belong to it. |
| [259](../config/mainsail.cfg#L259) | <code>##### get user parameters or use default #####</code> | Comment only; Klipper does not execute this line. |
| [260](../config/mainsail.cfg#L260) | <code>{% set client = printer[&#x27;gcode_macro _CLIENT_VARIABLE&#x27;]&#124;default({}) %}</code> | Calculate local <code>client</code> from <code>the stored state of _CLIENT_VARIABLE (use {} if absent)</code>. It lasts for this evaluation only. |
| [261](../config/mainsail.cfg#L261) | <code>{% set use_fw_retract = (client.use_fw_retract&#124;default(false)&#124;lower == &#x27;true&#x27;) and (printer.firmware_retraction is defined) %}</code> | Use firmware retraction only if the client requests it and the firmware_retraction module actually exists; otherwise use explicit E moves. |
| [262](../config/mainsail.cfg#L262) | <code>{% set length = params.LENGTH&#124;default(client.unretract)&#124;default(1.0)&#124;float %}</code> | Calculate local <code>length</code> from <code>the supplied LENGTH argument (use client.unretract if absent) (use 1.0 if absent) as a decimal</code>. It lasts for this evaluation only. |
| [263](../config/mainsail.cfg#L263) | <code>{% set speed = params.SPEED&#124;default(client.speed_unretract)&#124;default(35) %}</code> | Calculate local <code>speed</code> from <code>the supplied SPEED argument (use client.speed_unretract if absent) (use 35 if absent)</code>. It lasts for this evaluation only. |
| [264](../config/mainsail.cfg#L264) | <code>{% set absolute_extrude = printer.gcode_move.absolute_extrude %}</code> | Calculate local <code>absolute_extrude</code> from <code>E uses absolute coordinates</code>. It lasts for this evaluation only. |

| [268](../config/mainsail.cfg#L268) | <code>{% if use_fw_retract %}</code> | Start a conditional branch: <code>use_fw_retract</code>. Only a true branch emits its commands. |
| [269](../config/mainsail.cfg#L269) | <code>{% if length &lt; 0 %}</code> | Start a conditional branch: <code>length &lt; 0</code>. Only a true branch emits its commands. |
| [270](../config/mainsail.cfg#L270) | <code>G10</code> | Request firmware retraction; requires the firmware_retraction module. |

XYZ follows G90/G91; E follows G91/M82/M83. Omitted axes and feed rate retain their previous values. |

<a id="gcode_macro-_client_retract"></a>

## gcode_macro _CLIENT_RETRACT

Convert the requested retract length to a negative magnitude and delegate to _CLIENT_EXTRUDE, which checks temperature. SPEED arguments use mm/s here, converted by that helper to G-code feed rate.

**Calls and state references:** [_CLIENT_EXTRUDE](mainsail.cfg.md#gcode_macro-_client_extrude), [_CLIENT_VARIABLE](macros/client.cfg.md#gcode_macro-_client_variable). Conditional references are not necessarily executed.

| Source line | Code | Plain explanation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [286](../config/mainsail.cfg#L286) | <code>[gcode_macro _CLIENT_RETRACT]</code> | Declare this callable macro. |
| [287](../config/mainsail.cfg#L287) | <code>description: Retracts, if the extruder is hot enough</code> | Set the help text: <code>Retracts, if the extruder is hot enough</code>. |
| [288](../config/mainsail.cfg#L288) | <code>gcode:</code> | Begin the command template. The following indented lines belong to it. |
| [289](../config/mainsail.cfg#L289) | <code>{% set client = printer[&#x27;gcode_macro _CLIENT_VARIABLE&#x27;]&#124;default({}) %}</code> | Calculate local <code>client</code> from <code>the stored state of _CLIENT_VARIABLE (use {} if absent)</code>. It lasts for this evaluation only. |
| [290](../config/mainsail.cfg#L290) | <code>{% set length = params.LENGTH&#124;default(client.retract)&#124;default(1.0)&#124;float %}</code> | Calculate local <code>length</code> from <code>the supplied LENGTH argument (use client.retract if absent) (use 1.0 if absent) as a decimal</code>. It lasts for this evaluation only. |
| [291](../config/mainsail.cfg#L291) | <code>{% set speed = params.SPEED&#124;default(client.speed_retract)&#124;default(35) %}</code> | Calculate local <code>speed</code> from <code>the supplied SPEED argument (use client.speed_retract if absent) (use 35 if absent)</code>. It lasts for this evaluation only. |
| [293](../config/mainsail.cfg#L293) | <code>_CLIENT_EXTRUDE LENGTH=-{length&#124;float&#124;abs} SPEED={speed&#124;float&#124;abs}</code> | Run [_CLIENT_EXTRUDE](mainsail.cfg.md#gcode_macro-_client_extrude), which is evaluated separately when reached. Forward <code>LENGTH=-{length&#124;float&#124;abs} SPEED={speed&#124;float&#124;abs}</code>. |

<a id="gcode_macro-_client_linear_move"></a>

## gcode_macro _CLIENT_LINEAR_MOVE

Build optional axis/feed arguments and perform a linear move inside saved/restored G-code state. It does not independently verify homing or temperature.
